notes: Authoritative source: Axis Communications official datasheet (T10151035/EN/M37.2/202511), cross-checked against the official installation guide's rear-panel diagrams. Datasheet's "Connectors" section explicitly lists: Rear side - 8x RJ45 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX PoE, 1x RJ45 10BASE-T/100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T, DC input; Side - 1x USB 3.0. Individual PoE port numbers (1-8) are not printed as text labels in the datasheet/guide (no per-port silkscreen callouts shown), so "PoE 1"-"PoE 8" naming is inferred from the 8-port grid shown in the installation guide's rear-panel illustration, not verbatim device silkscreen. USB connector shape (Type-A) is inferred from product photography in the datasheet/guide, not stated as text; USB 3.0 mapped to usb-5g (SuperSpeed 5Gbps) grade per standard USB naming. Sold in three storage variants (2TB/4TB/8TB) with identical I/O; PoE power budget differs slightly by variant (65W for 2TB/4TB models, 60W for the 8TB model) due to internal power allocation to the larger drive - this does not change the port list. Device is a compact desktop unit (180x180x53mm); rack-mounting is only possible via the optional AXIS TW8100 Rack Mount accessory, so rackUnits was omitted. Power input section is slightly ambiguous in the datasheet (states "Power supply: max 90W" separately from "Recorder: 1.88A, 48V DC, max 90W" while the included adapter is rated 180W) - the DC Input port on the recorder itself is 48V DC, max 90W, fed from the external AC/DC brick, which is the correct physical-port characterization.
